groups.name: code
groups.summary: Execute a C# snippet, batch several command operations in one round trip, or run a menu item.

actions.name: run
actions.summary: Compile and invoke a C# method body, returning its value as JSON.

actions.name: batch
actions.summary: Run several registered command operations in one round trip.

actions.name: menu
actions.summary: Execute a menu item by its exact path.

actions.name: history
actions.summary: List recently executed snippets.

actions.name: clear-history
actions.summary: Delete the snippet history.

actions.name: replay
actions.summary: Re-run a snippet from history by index.

code.description: action=run: the BODY of 'public static object Execute()'. Return a value to receive it as JSON.

file.description: action=run: read the snippet from a file instead of 'code'.

safetyChecks.description: Substring blacklist only; NOT a sandbox.

operations.description: action=batch: [{ command, action, args }] or MCP-style [{ tool, params }].

groups.name: memory
groups.summary: Read-only asset and object audits: dangling references, reverse references, duplicate content, unreachable assets.

actions.name: audit
actions.summary: Scan assets for dangling serialized references and report counts by asset type.

actions.name: objects
actions.summary: Count loaded objects by type and estimate their memory, largest first.

actions.name: references
actions.summary: Find which assets reference a given asset, plus its own dependency count.

actions.name: deps
actions.summary: List what a given asset depends on, transitively by default.

actions.name: duplicates
actions.summary: Group assets whose content fingerprint is identical.

actions.name: unused
actions.summary: List assets that no scene or prefab in the project reaches (candidates, not a verdict).

path.description: action=references: the asset to find referencers of.

folder.description: Restrict the scan to this folder. Defaults to Assets.

typeName.description: action=objects: only count loaded objects of this type.

maxScan.description: How many assets a scan may examine before it reports truncation.

minSize.description: action=duplicates: ignore files smaller than this many bytes.

allScenes.description: action=unused: use every scene in the project, not just the enabled build scenes.

includeEmpty.description: action=objects: include types with zero loaded instances.

groups.name: profiler
groups.summary: Unity Profiler：会话开关与还原、帧计时、计数器（分页）、对象内存、内存快照、Frame Debugger。

actions.name: status
actions.summary: 报告 Profiler 与各 area 的当前开关状态，以及是否有可还原的会话快照。

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: 连通性探测。

actions.name: start
actions.summary: 开启 Profiler；可选写二进制日志与采集分配调用栈。开始前会记录原状态。

actions.name: stop
actions.summary: 关闭 Profiler 并还原 start 之前的状态，避免污染下一次采样。

actions.name: set-areas
actions.summary: 按 ProfilerArea 枚举名逐项开关采集区域。

actions.name: frame-timing
actions.summary: 读取最近一帧的 CPU/GPU 帧计时；未开启 Frame Timing Stats 时给出可诊断说明。

actions.name: counters
actions.summary: 读取某个 ProfilerCategory 下的计数器（分页 + 名称过滤 + 扫描上限）。

actions.name: object-memory
actions.summary: 按场景层级路径或资产路径查询单个对象的运行时内存占用。

actions.name: snapshot-take
actions.summary: 用 Memory Profiler 包抓取 .snap 快照（异步 + 超时 + 取消）。

actions.name: snapshot-list
actions.summary: 列出 .snap 快照文件及其大小与创建时间（分页）。

actions.name: snapshot-compare
actions.summary: 比较两个快照的文件级元数据（不做对象级 diff）。

actions.name: frame-debugger-enable
actions.summary: 开启 Frame Debugger；Play Mode 未暂停时拒绝并提示先暂停。

actions.name: frame-debugger-disable
actions.summary: 关闭 Frame Debugger。

actions.name: frame-debugger-events
actions.summary: 按游标分页读取 Frame Debugger 事件列表。

actions.name: profiler_status
actions.summary: Alias of status (MCP spelling).

actions.name: profiler_start
actions.summary: Alias of start (MCP spelling).

actions.name: profiler_stop
actions.summary: Alias of stop (MCP spelling).

actions.name: profiler_set_areas
actions.summary: Alias of set-areas (MCP spelling).

actions.name: get_frame_timing
actions.summary: Alias of frame-timing (MCP spelling).

actions.name: get_counters
actions.summary: Alias of counters (MCP spelling).

actions.name: get_object_memory
actions.summary: Alias of object-memory (MCP spelling).

actions.name: memory_take_snapshot
actions.summary: Alias of snapshot-take (MCP spelling).

actions.name: memory_list_snapshots
actions.summary: Alias of snapshot-list (MCP spelling).

actions.name: memory_compare_snapshots
actions.summary: Alias of snapshot-compare (MCP spelling).

actions.name: frame_debugger_enable
actions.summary: Alias of frame-debugger-enable (MCP spelling).

actions.name: frame_debugger_disable
actions.summary: Alias of frame-debugger-disable (MCP spelling).

actions.name: frame_debugger_get_events
actions.summary: Alias of frame-debugger-events (MCP spelling).

logFile.description: start: 二进制日志输出路径；目录必须已存在。也接受 log_file.

enableCallstacks.description: start: 采集分配调用栈。也接受 enable_callstacks.

areas.description: set-areas: 键为 ProfilerArea 枚举名（大小写不敏感），值为布尔。例如把 CPU 设为 true、GPU 设为 false。

category.description: counters: ProfilerCategory 名，如 Render / Scripts / Memory / Physics。

counters.description: counters: 只看名称包含这些子串的计数器；省略则按名称顺序取前 maxCounters 个。

maxCounters.description: counters: 扫描上限；命中更多时会标记 scanTruncated。也接受 max_counters.

objectPath.description: object-memory: 场景层级路径或资产路径。也接受 object_path.

snapshotPath.description: snapshot-take: 输出 .snap 路径；省略则写入临时缓存目录。也接受 snapshot_path.

searchPath.description: snapshot-list: 搜索目录；省略则搜临时缓存与工程根两处。也接受 search_path.

snapshotA.description: snapshot-compare: 第一个快照文件。也接受 snapshot_a.

snapshotB.description: snapshot-compare: 第二个快照文件。也接受 snapshot_b.

timeoutSeconds.description: snapshot-take: 等待快照完成的秒数。也接受 timeout_seconds.

groups.name: reflect
groups.summary: Look up loaded types, their members and their signatures. Answers come from this Editor's real assemblies.

actions.name: get-type
actions.summary: Describe one type: kind, namespace, assembly and the members it declares itself.

actions.name: get-member
actions.summary: Resolve a single member by name, searching base types.

actions.name: search
actions.summary: Find types and members whose name contains a fragment (capped, paged).

typeName.description: get-type / get-member: short or fully qualified type name.

memberName.description: get-member: member to resolve, searched up the base chain.

includeInherited.description: get-type: include members inherited from base types. False by default, matching MCP; pass true (or declaredOnly: false) for the full callable surface.

declaredOnly.description: get-type: list only the members this type declares itself. True by default, matching MCP's get_type.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page.
